requirement_details.description: Assess missing intent and important edge cases in every planning entry point.
Resolve questions into observable requirements without redundant interviews.
Preserve CLI prompt contracts across free-text, task and legacy invocations.
Deliver verified canonical and packaged guidance.

acceptance_checks.procedure: Review canonical/packaged guidance and try an ambiguous feature request.
acceptance_checks.expected: Focused questions follow discovery and precede final decisions.

acceptance_checks.procedure: Exercise clear, ambiguous, answered, skipped and deferred-question scenarios.
acceptance_checks.expected: Answers map to acceptance examples; unresolved material intent blocks READY.

acceptance_checks.procedure: Run focused CLI regressions and compare task bytes before/after.
acceptance_checks.expected: Host, location, profile and prompt equivalence survive; no record mutation.

acceptance_checks.procedure: Run planning/execution/distribution tests, parity, skill validation and independent review.
acceptance_checks.expected: All required checks pass and fresh installs contain updated guidance.

decisions.choice: Make missing-intent assessment part of every plan.
decisions.consequences: Clear requests need no question quota; material gaps are assessed by default.
decisions.reopen_if: Reopen if actual use still omits material clarification.

decisions.choice: Use focused rounds, normally one to three related questions.
decisions.consequences: Further rounds address remaining material gaps without overwhelming the user.
decisions.reopen_if: Reopen if real planning interactions leave users unable to express relevant intent.

decisions.choice: Reuse authored plan questions and existing unresolved_questions.
alternatives: Introduce a new structured question schema
decisions.consequences: No migration; authored answers link to requirements and checks while unresolved blockers remain machine-visible.
decisions.reopen_if: Reopen if automated question lifecycle tooling is requested.

decisions.choice: Preserve readiness, authority and review rules.
alternatives: Block on all optional future ideas
decisions.consequences: Material unanswered decisions block READY; excluded/deferred ideas with rationale do not.
decisions.reopen_if: Reopen if an actual decision cannot fit existing draft/blocked/conditional readiness semantics.

evidence.source: Current chat: feature request and selected focused clarification rounds
